name: @ozjsey/v-select-text
description: Vue 3 directive for reactive text selection — select the rendered text of any element by range or pattern, optionally copying it, plus inputs, textareas and contenteditable
author: Ozgur Seyidoglu

scripts.build: tsup vSelectText.ts --format esm,cjs --minify --sourcemap --dts --out-dir dist --clean && mv dist/vSelectText.js dist/vSelectText.min.js && mv dist/vSelectText.js.map dist/vSelectText.min.js.map && mv dist/vSelectText.cjs dist/vSelectText.min.cjs && mv dist/vSelectText.cjs.map dist/vSelectText.min.cjs.map && mv dist/vSelectText.d.cts dist/vSelectText.min.d.cts && node -e "const fs=require('fs');for(const f of ['vSelectText.min.js','vSelectText.min.cjs']){const p='dist/'+f;let s=fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8');s=s.replace(/\/\/# sourceMappingURL=vSelectText\.(js|cjs)\.map/, '//# sourceMappingURL='+f+'.map');fs.writeFileSync(p,s);}"
